## Outcome
The first use-case world—Company Research in Discovery Blue—is ready for Petter's review.
- Reuses the Spotify AB registry example as the recurring proof object.
- Shows Company News and Country Economic Indicators only as separate possible next calls.
- Removes the unsupported funding implication from the original working copy.
- Uses a generated atmosphere with no text, UI, logos, values or claims.
- Reconstructs all product evidence deterministically from a dated live-catalog audit.
